snippet.title: Brush Burial - Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Brush Burial is a retro-inspired First Person Snatcher. Steal shiny trinkets and befriend thieves, brigands, and other charming troublemakers as you navigate hand-crafted environments blending the boundaries between the digital, the industrial, the natural, and the spiritual.
